newsitem.title: USA: FP&L sees St Lucie 1 at 60 pct for 2 weeks.
newsitem.headline: FP&L sees St Lucie 1 at 60 pct for 2 weeks.

text.p: Florida Power & Light Co's 839 megawatt St Lucie nuclear unit 1 will likely operate at reduced power for the next two weeks, the company said Friday.
"It's at 60 percent power and will remain at this level until repairs on one of our main transformers are complete," said company spokeswoman Janice Brady.
Repairs are expected to take about two weeks, Brady added.
The Hutchinson Island, Fla., unit was shut last Saturday after a leak was detected in one of the unit's transformers, which is in the non-nuclear side of the plant.
The company previously said that the unit would likely restart this week.
